gates.description: Run Node against a disposable clone of the exact MariaDB schema and Redis key/cache contract, then reconcile rows, counters, finite-pool saturation, acquisition deadlines and failure modes.
Compare PHP and Node redirect decisions and bounded audit output for the same sanitized traffic corpus, including Meta, datacenter, replay, country, diversion and cookies.
Implement and reconcile D2 delivered-country observation, publisher, history and truthful report semantics.
Complete registration, public pages, dashboard, Admin, history, shield statistics, single-domain full flow and configurable shared-account policy.
Prove atomic concurrent admission, upload/BullMQ reconciliation, and receipt-backed ownership/orphan retention across Redis/web/worker crashes, retries, restarts, disk-full and backup/restore.

Verify the exact Node/Sharp build, static exclusions, Host/protocol/client IP/country trust, spoof handling, body limits, buffering, timeouts, persistent paths, Redis connection count, PM2 reboot recovery and log rotation on the isolated pilot.
Replace or explicitly approve the inherited plaintext ip-api fallback with bounded privacy, availability and rate-limit behavior.
Pass the all-source coverage thresholds and targeted tests for bootstrap, MariaDB, Redis, BullMQ and worker failure paths.
Benchmark feature-equivalent PHP and Node on the same 1-vCPU/2-GB shape and confirm acceptable CPU, RAM, latency and throughput.
Prove every accepted pilot-to-release runtime configuration difference, then approve the one-writer cutover, DNS rollback, database compatibility and exact acceptance checklist.
Record explicit owner authorization for the exact isolated pilot target after all technical pilot-candidate gates pass.
Record separate explicit owner authorization for the exact production cutover target.
